title.zh: 加拿大政府与英伟达参与Cohere融资，后者估值超200亿美元
title.en: 加拿大政府与英伟达参与Cohere融资，后者估值超200亿美元

current_state.zh: Cohere closed the first tranche of a financing round valuing it at $20.5B and targeting up to $5B total, with the Canadian government committing up to $1.14B and Nvidia among the investors, alongside plans for roughly $1.2B in new Canadian compute infrastructure by 2030.
